subject: PO 7731 payment hold -> aging reclassification & journal correction plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <accounts-payable@blueskyanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jon Keller <jon.keller@blueskyanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Payment hold - PO #7731 (invoice INV-7731)

Hi Grace / Laura,

Quick note from AP: our payment to Redwood for INV-7731 is on hold. Our PO#7731 total (EUR 62,400) does not match the amount on the invoice (EUR 61,200). Because of the discrepancy and unclear VAT reclaim information, Treasury has placed the payment in a hold status pending clarification.

Can you please confirm the correct invoiced amount and provide a corrected invoice or a credit memo? We also need the VAT breakdown (taxable base vs VAT amount) explicitly shown on the document so our VAT recovery team can process it.

Attachment: PO_7731.pdf

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Accounts Payable Manager
BlueSky Analytics
[Attachment: PO_7731.pdf]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <accounts-payable@blueskyanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - PO #7731 (invoice INV-7731)

Hi Marta — thanks for flagging this.

Quick summary from our side: INV-7731 was generated after a mid-term seat count change; there should have been a prorated line for the 2 extra seats (EUR 1,200) but it looks like the VAT line was omitted on the exported PDF. We're pulling the AR aging and the invoice trace now — attaching the aging snapshot so you can see the invoice posting.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Redwood to issue a corrected invoice or credit + replacement invoice showing VAT lines (we can do a credit memo to zero out the original and reissue).
- Finance to post a one-line journal correction to move INV-7731 from 90+ days suspense to standard AR once the credit is posted.
- Request BlueSky to release the held payment once the corrected documents are received (or confirm they need a Supplier Statement match).

I'll loop Marcus and Laura to draft the journal/credit. Can you confirm whether BlueSky requires a signed credit memo or if an emailed corrected invoice is acceptable for release?

Attachment: aging-snapshot-2027-01-25.csv

Best,
Grace
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: aging-snapshot-2027-01-25.csv]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <accounts-payable@blueskyanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jan 2027 08:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - PO #7731 (invoice INV-7731) 

Morning team — I drafted a journal correction and a proposed credit memo to reverse the original invoice and reissue with the VAT line. Key notes:
- Journal will debit AR (suspense) and credit revenue control for the exact original invoice amount (EUR 61,200) on 2027-01-28.
- We will post the credit memo the same day and reissue corrected invoice INV-7731-REV (EUR 62,400) showing VAT EUR 6,240 (10% example rate).
- I included a quick mapping to revenue recognition buckets so Revenue Ops can run downstream revrec adjustments: lines for subscription base vs prorate delta.

Please review the attached XLSX and sign off by EOD 26 Jan if ok — Marcus, can you validate the revrec mapping? Grace, I'll need your go-ahead to post the journal on Friday morning.

Attachment: journal-correction-draft.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
AR Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: journal-correction-draft.xlsx]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <accounts-payable@blueskyanalytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jon Keller <jon.keller@blueskyanalytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Jan 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold - PO #7731 (invoice INV-7731) 

Thanks everyone — final update.

Laura & Marcus: thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal sign-off (Finance + RevOps), we will:
- Post the journal correction on 2027-01-28 at 09:00 UTC to move INV-7731 into AR (normal bucket) and clear the suspense code.
- Issue Credit Memo CM-7731 for EUR 61,200 and reissue corrected invoice INV-7731-REV for EUR 62,400 with explicit VAT lines.

Marta / Jon: once you receive CM-7731 and INV-7731-REV we request BlueSky to release the payment hold. If Treasury requires a signed credit memo, please advise and we'll provide an exported PDF with an authorized signature block.

I'll attach the final posted journal reference once completed and update the NetSuite record (NetSuite#INV-7731). If anything changes on your end, call me directly (mobile included in my signature).

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
